title: Formula for Torque
text: The torque $$\tau$$ is related to angular acceleration by $$\tau=I\alpha$$.

title: Kinematics of Rotational Motion
text: Based on the formula $$\omega_{f}=\omega_{i}+\alpha{}t,$$ and since the final angular velocity $$\omega_{f}$$ is $$0$$ (the gymnast stops spinning), $$t=\frac{-\omega_{i}}{\alpha}.$$ Here $$\alpha$$ is negative because the torque slows the spin.
